summary: Dealer Parts spreadsheet full-sheet scan + chunked upload verified end-to-end. Backend: chunk-uploaded the raw Sage-export xlsx (~43 KB, 138 cols × 64 rows) and finish-invoice returned available=true, source='spreadsheet_scan', matched_count=20, order_value=63505.64. Machines 348H-AAA (qty 3), 695C-AAA (qty 1) and 302H-AAO (qty 2) all present with matched=true, match_method='exact_ref' and a machine_description; traceable-serial rows correctly deduped (348H-AAA=3, not 9). Second finish-invoice on the same upload_id → 404 (temp file removed). LLM path still intact for plain .txt invoice with '305H-ZZY' → matched=true, exact_ref, matched_count>=1. Dealer user (portal2@fitline.test) gets 403 on /upload/init, /finish-invoice and /ai-parse-invoice. Frontend: Allocation Wizard tab renders, dp-wiz-ai-status status bar becomes visible while the file uploads/parses, after completion all 20 machine inputs populate (dp-wiz-machine-0='348H-AAA'), dp-wiz-value=63505.64, dp-wiz-ai-info shows 'Extracted 20 machine line(s), 20 matched to BOM' plus the scan note, Generate advances to dp-wiz-step1 cleanly. Pack value = £0 as expected (approved-only gating — noted, not a bug).

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning '<option> cannot be a child of <span>' still present; unrelated to this change but ships to console.
CSP still blocks emergent-main.js, posthog and cloudflareinsights beacon (script-src). Pre-existing, no functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/dealer_parts_data.py _scan_spreadsheet_invoice: quantity clamp `if qty <= 0 or qty > 100000: qty = 1` silently reassigns qty=1 for a legitimate zero (e.g. credit-note lines). Consider skipping the line instead so a credit doesn't inflate matched_count.

routes/dealer_parts_data.py _parse_and_match_invoice: on spreadsheet_scan we return matched_count directly from the scan but never fall back to the LLM if a spreadsheet has zero deterministic hits — falls through to parse_invoice_file which then re-parses the whole workbook. This works but double-parses large workbooks; consider passing the already-loaded text if the scan yielded zero to save cost.

routes/dealer_parts_data.py finish-invoice: temp file deletion is in a `finally` block but the read is unconditional even if session missing; the 404 path is correct. Consider streaming the read instead of `content = fh.read()` for very large invoices (currently OK — Sage exports are small).

utils/dealer_parts_ai.py spreadsheet_rows: opens workbook without a max-cell guard; a maliciously huge xlsx (millions of cells) could OOM the worker. Consider a cell-count cap or a size cap on decompressed content.
